n: <int> Number of suppliers in the transportation network.
m: <int> Number of customers in the transportation network.
num_arcs: <int> Total number of shipping arcs in the bipartite network, equal to n times m.
num_variables: <int> Total number of flow variables in the model, equal to n times m plus n.
num_constraints: <int> Total number of constraints in the model, equal to m plus n.
cost_type: <str> Type of arc cost function used: 'linear_integer', 'linear_fractional', or 'quadratic'.
relative_demand_slack: <float> Ratio of excess total supply beyond total demand to total supply.
arc_capacity: <int> Upper bound on the flow that can be shipped on any single arc.
supplier_locations: <list[list[float]], shape [n][2]> Two-dimensional spatial coordinates for each supplier.
customer_locations: <list[list[float]], shape [m][2]> Two-dimensional spatial coordinates for each customer.
supplies: <list[int], length n> Maximum total flow that each supplier can ship across all its outgoing arcs.
demands: <list[int], length m> Quantity of flow that must arrive at each customer from all suppliers combined.
linear_costs: <list[list[int|float]], shape [n][m]> Per-unit shipping cost on the arc from each supplier to each customer.
quadratic_costs: <list[list[int|float]], shape [n][m]> Quadratic cost coefficient on the arc from each supplier to each customer, applied to the square of the flow.
